scope: Local Chromium desktop; interactive pagination with the 217850-word large synthetic inputs. Native PDF dialog timing is outside this browser API boundary. The historical capacity protocol still applies to its 6/30/118-section corpus.
method: Wall-clock elapsed from user action to corresponding progress or idle. After-close retained heap is post-GC CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage on the same target. No extrapolation to native memory, foreground mobile or background-throttled tabs.
